errors.limit: Too many tries. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
errors.unavailable: Signing in is not possible right now. Try again later.

errors.invalidInput: Some fields are filled in wrongly. Correct the marked fields and save again.
errors.signedOut: Your session has ended. Sign in again, then repeat the action.
errors.notFound: Not found. It may have been removed, or it belongs to a branch you do not work in.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this. Ask the Procurement Head if you need it.
errors.staleVersion: Someone changed this while you had it open. Reload the page to see the new version, then try again.
errors.wrongStatus: This cannot be done at the current status. Reload the page to see where it stands now.
errors.conflict: This was moved to another branch or person while you were working. Reload the page and check before trying again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong and nothing was saved. Try again; if it happens again, tell the Procurement Head.
errors.network: The connection was lost. Reload the page to see whether your change was saved.
